facts.fact: The Times of Zambia reports the Judiciary has launched its nationwide Electronic Case Management System, with the initial rollout a pilot phase in four registries at the Lusaka High Court and Kitwe High Court buildings.

ZMB.note: 24-hour e-filing is described as what the guidelines provide for, in a pilot still beginning, so no online-filing fact is recorded.
